intro: This privacy policy applies only to the specific FullParty site or service where it is published. If you are using a self-hosted or forked copy of FullParty, the operator of that instance must replace or adapt this policy so it accurately reflects their own data practices.
FullParty is a platform for managing groups, applications, rosters, characters, notifications, and related activity for online gaming communities.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: If you have questions about this privacy policy or want to exercise your data protection rights, you can contact us at {contact}.

sections.title: What information we collect
bullets: Account information such as your email address, username, password hash if you set one, avatar, and account preferences.
Social login and linked account information you choose to connect, such as provider account IDs, display names, avatars, and email addresses returned by the provider.
Character information such as Lodestone or game-related identifiers, claimed characters, primary character selection, classes, jobs, and profile data imported or refreshed at your request.
Group and activity information such as group memberships, moderation roles, applications, roster assignments, check-ins, notes, bans, and audit log entries.
Notification and communication data such as your notification preferences, inbox state, delivery records, and system notice read state.
Technical and security information such as IP address, browser or device user agent, session records, request metadata, and security or abuse-prevention logs.

sections.title: Where we get personal information from
bullets: Directly from you when you create an account, edit your profile, connect accounts, submit applications, join groups, or otherwise use FullParty.
From social authentication providers when you sign in or link an account through services such as Google, Discord, or XIVAuth.
From raid log or character data providers when you ask FullParty to import or refresh information, including services such as FF Logs or Lodestone-related sources.
From other users when they manage groups, rosters, moderation notes, invitations, or other shared features that involve your account or characters.

sections.title: Why we use your information
bullets: To create and manage your account and let you sign in securely.
To provide core product features such as groups, applications, rosters, notifications, and character management.
To operate moderation, safety, anti-abuse, and audit logging features.
To send service-related emails and other communications, including important operational or security notices.
To troubleshoot, secure, maintain, and improve FullParty.
To comply with legal obligations where applicable.

sections.title: Our lawful bases
paragraphs: We usually process your personal information because it is necessary to provide the service you ask us to provide, including account access, group participation, applications, rosters, and notifications.
We also process information where it is in our legitimate interests to run, secure, moderate, and improve FullParty, provided those interests are not overridden by your rights and freedoms.
Where we rely on consent, such as for certain optional communications or optional account connections you choose to enable, you can withdraw that consent at any time.

sections.title: Who we share information with
paragraphs: We share personal information only where needed to run FullParty lawfully and effectively.
bullets: Hosting, infrastructure, and storage providers.
Email delivery and related communication providers.
Social authentication providers you choose to use.
Character, identity, or raid log data providers you ask FullParty to query or import from.
Professional advisers, law enforcement, regulators, or other parties where disclosure is required or reasonably necessary to protect rights, safety, or the service.

sections.title: International transfers
paragraphs: Some of the providers we use may process personal information outside your country, including outside the UK or EEA. Where that happens, we aim to use providers and arrangements that offer an appropriate level of protection under applicable data protection law.

sections.title: How long we keep information
bullets: We keep account and profile information for as long as your account remains active and for a reasonable period afterwards where needed for security, dispute handling, legal compliance, or record integrity.
We keep group, application, roster, audit, and moderation records for as long as needed to preserve operational history, accountability, and service integrity.
We keep notification and delivery records for as long as reasonably necessary to operate communications, troubleshoot issues, and maintain auditability.
We may delete or anonymise information sooner where it is no longer needed, and we may keep information longer where required by law or where necessary to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you are located and the law that applies, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, object to, or move some of your personal information.
You may also have the right to withdraw consent where consent is the basis for processing.
To make a request, contact {contact}. We may need to verify your identity before acting on your request.

sections.title: How to complain
paragraphs: If you have concerns about how we use your personal information, please contact us first at {contact}.
If you are in the UK, you can also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO): https://ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint/.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. When we do, we will update the 'Last updated' date on this page.

intro: This cookie policy applies only to the specific FullParty site or service where it is published. Self-hosted or forked copies of FullParty should replace or adapt this page so it accurately describes their own cookie and storage usage.
This cookie policy explains how this FullParty service uses cookies and similar technologies on the site.
At the moment, FullParty primarily uses cookies and related storage for essential security, sign-in, session handling, and user-selected preferences.

sections.title: What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They help the site remember information about your visit, such as whether you are signed in or which preferences you selected.

sections.title: Cookies and similar technologies we use
bullets: Session and authentication cookies, which help keep you signed in, maintain secure sessions, and protect account access.
Security and request-validation cookies, including cookies used to support CSRF protection and secure form submissions.
Preference cookies, such as the cookie used to remember your selected interface language.

sections.title: Why we use them
bullets: To let you log in and stay signed in while using FullParty.
To secure requests and reduce abuse or misuse of the service.
To remember settings you explicitly choose, such as your locale or language preference.
To keep the service stable and usable during normal operation.

sections.title: Cookies we currently rely on
bullets: A session cookie used by the Laravel application to maintain your session.
A CSRF-related cookie used to help validate requests.
A locale cookie used to remember your selected language.

sections.title: Consent
paragraphs: Based on the current setup of FullParty, these cookies are used for essential service functionality and user-requested preferences rather than advertising or optional behavioural tracking.
If FullParty later adds non-essential analytics, marketing, or similar tracking technologies that require consent, we will update this policy and implement an appropriate consent flow.

sections.title: Managing cookies
paragraphs: You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings. However, if you block essential cookies, parts of FullParty may stop working properly, including sign-in, security features, and saved preferences.
